deviations.decision: Damage is not implemented in MVP 0.4 and moves to a later V0.4.x gate.
deviations.reason: Damage touches Runner hidden hand, RandomDrawRecords, Undo barriers and AI visibility.

deviations.decision: Deck validation only supports curated internal decks.
deviations.reason: Free deckbuilding, influence and format legality remain out of scope.

deviations.decision: Tags are applied directly by internal card effects; no trace system is implemented.
deviations.reason: Tags are the first rule slice; trace is a later dedicated mechanic.
